title: Three Months and One Short Beam
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：tube　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tube 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the builder ① laid the tube that no assistant in the site would have measured, and he said the laying was the whole of the month. The ② tube, meaning the pipe itself and not the beam, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; a tube, he said, is the only thing in a site that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ tube in that site had the same short beam beside it, and the ④ tube at the far wall, meaning the brick they kept for the children to lay and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A tube, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the builder said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tube was the whole of the matter, meaning the flow and not the pipe. The ⑥ tube, meaning the flow and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; tube, he said, is either something you lay or the only word that means both a pipe and a flow. He said the flow is the part they remember.

By 1985 the ⑦ tube had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short beam. The ⑧ tube of the whole thing, the builder wrote in October, was one site and three months of measuring; tube, he said, is either the brick at the far wall or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tube I remember is the pipe measured in the plan, which closed in 1987 and is still measured as the quietest in the site. A ⑩ tube, my mother said in 1989, is the only pipe that improves by being measured; every tube, she said, is a flow that has agreed to look like a pipe. She said the flow was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 管子；地铁（指工地里每一根旁边的那一根）
B. n. 管子；地铁（指那根管子本身，与短短的横梁相对）
C. 固定搭配：lay the tube 铺这一根管子
D. n. 管子；地铁（指留给孩子们砌的那一块）
E. n. 管子之事（抽象总称，指一处工地的管子之事）
F. n. 管子；地铁（指施工图里写到、被测量的那一根）
G. n. 管子、流通（指一件事里人人都建却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 流通（抽象总称，指人人都建却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: laid the tube that no assistant in the site would have measured
The tube, meaning the pipe itself and not the beam
the tube at the far wall
the tube was the whole of the matter
the tube had become a line in a plan
The tube of the whole thing
A tube, my mother said in 1989

answers.why: lay the tube 意为“铺这一根管子”，1980 年那位施工员把工地里没有一位帮工肯测量的一根管子做了一遍。
tube 意为“管子；地铁”，指那根管子本身而不是短短的横梁，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
tube 意为“管子；地铁”，指工地里每一根旁边的那一根，每一根旁边都有同一根短短的横梁。
tube 意为“管子；地铁”，指最远那面墙体的留给孩子们砌的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tube 意为“管子、流通”，指一件事里人人都建却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这根流通就是那件事的全部。
tube 意为“流通”，指人人都建却无人提起的那样东西而不是那根管子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tube 意为“管子；地铁”，指施工图里写到、被测量的那一根，到 1985 年这一根成了施工图里的一行。
tube 意为“管子之事”，施工员十月写道，整件事的管子之事是一处工地和三个月份的测量。
tube 意为“管子；地铁”，我记得的是施工图里测量过的那一根，1987 年建成了，至今仍被说成工地里最安静的一根。
tube 为抽象总称，母亲 1989 年说，管子是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的管子。
